# gifenc 1.0.3

Upstream: https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc

Pinned bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gifenc@1.0.3/dist/gifenc.esm.js

License source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gifenc@1.0.3/LICENSE.md

Retrieved: 2026-09-08. MIT license retained in LICENSE.md and prepended to the served bundle. Removed the upstream source-map reference because the map is not distributed here. No runtime CDN requests or npm dependency installation.

Used for 256-color per-frame palette quantization and GIF encoding in a dedicated Worker. Browser video/canvas APIs perform decoding and frame extraction.
